logline: Each season dramatises the rise and fall of a real Indian gangster - from Gorakhpur's most wanted criminal in the 1990s to a Rajasthan outlaw to a Bihar gangster-turned-politician - tracing how ordinary men became legends of violence.

renewal.note: Three-season anthology run concluded with Rangbaaz: Darr Ki Rajneeti in July 2022. No further seasons announced.

bollymeter.basis: Grounded in the real story of gangster Shri Prakash Shukla, Season 1 earned strong audience response on ZEE5 and critic praise for its Gorakhpur authenticity, period craft, and Saqib Saleem's committed lead performance.

pull_quotes.text: A binge-watching worthy gangster drama with a heart - one of ZEE5's few offerings with real substance in writing and treatment.

seasons.review_body: The first season of Rangbaaz zeroes in on the real-life criminal career of Shri Prakash Shukla, who terrorised Gorakhpur and eastern UP through the 1990s before being killed in a 1998 police encounter. Director Bhav Dhulia grounds the storytelling in period texture - the crumbling towns, the political patronage networks, the police-criminal nexus - while Saqib Saleem invests the role with a menace that avoids easy glorification. Indian critics and ZEE5 subscribers received it warmly as one of the platform's first quality originals. IWMBuzz called it 'an intense, hard-hitting tale.' The show's eight-episode arc keeps pace taut, and the real-events framing gives the violence moral weight rather than pulp spectacle. Viewer reception on IMDb settled around 7.8, signalling durable appreciation among crime-drama fans.

episode_reviews.title: Apaharan
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The series premiere establishes young Shiv Prakash Shukla's Gorakhpur as a world where caste, political muscle and criminal opportunity are inseparable. Direction keeps the period texture grounded rather than stylised.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The opening kidnapping that gives the episode its title - the act that sets Shukla on his irreversible path.

bollymeter.basis: Rangbaaz Phirse shifts geography to Rajasthan and swaps Saqib Saleem for Jimmy Shergill, retaining the anthology's real-criminal template while drawing mixed but largely positive viewer response.

seasons.review_body: Season 2 - subtitled Rangbaaz Phirse - relocates to Rajasthan and dramatises the story of gangster Anandpal Singh through a new lead cast including Jimmy Shergill and Gul Panag. The anthology format works in the show's favour: a fresh geography and lead actor reset expectations, and the desert-country milieu adds visual variety absent from Season 1. Trade coverage noted the season sustained the franchise's brand of grounded, real-events crime storytelling. Viewer reception on IMDb held near the first season's mark, suggesting the format transfer succeeded without the original's breakthrough energy.
seasons.season_over_season: Season 2 swaps Gorakhpur for Rajasthan and introduces a new gangster mythology, trading Saqib Saleem's raw intensity for Jimmy Shergill's more seasoned menace.

bollymeter.basis: Rangbaaz: Darr Ki Rajneeti adds a political layer to the gangster template with Vineet Kumar Singh anchoring a Bihar-set story, earning reviewer praise for performance while drawing mild criticism for timeline juggling.

pull_quotes.text: If you enjoyed the first two seasons, you'll definitely like Rangbaaz Season 3 - it's easily the best of the lot.

seasons.review_body: The third and final season, Rangbaaz: Darr Ki Rajneeti, narrows to six tighter episodes and shifts to Bihar, following Haroon Shah Ali Baig - a gangster-turned-politician whose rise and fall mirrors the corrupting logic of electoral power. Vineet Kumar Singh, already familiar to crime-drama audiences from Mirzapur, brings nuance to a character the show refuses to lionise. Binged praised it as the strongest season creatively, though the back-and-forth timeline structure drew some criticism for taxing viewer memory. At six episodes, it is the leanest instalment and the most politically pointed, closing the franchise on a note that extends the ZEE5 crime-drama tradition into the world of democratic muscle.
seasons.season_over_season: Season 3 condenses to six episodes and escalates from gangster biography to political thriller, marking the franchise's most structurally ambitious - if occasionally convoluted - chapter.
